micron_interpretation: Table 13 states Min/Max/Typ capacitance but does not explicitly define in-circuit effective capacitance, test voltage, temperature, frequency, tolerance or aging basis. Do not silently interpret these numbers as either guaranteed effective minima or a tolerance-free nominal-only requirement. Nominal selections fall in the printed ranges; operating compliance remains unresolved.
model: For an engineering budget only, Ceff = Cnom*(1+initial_error)*(1+no_bias_temperature_error)*k. k absorbs actual DC/AC voltage, aging, process, lot and interacting effects; it is unknown. The separate +/-10% and no-bias +/-15% limits are not a combined guarantee. A validated bound on k plus applicability of those limits is required before using the interval.

C69_C71.meaning: The lower condition cannot be met by a loss-only k <= 1 at the chosen worst-case tolerance/temperature corner. This is an engineering sensitivity result, not proof Micron requires effective >= 2.2uF.

C65.meaning: A literal all-effects exactly 100nF range is incompatible with the component tolerance envelope; obtain the intended component specification basis.

thermal_conditions.note: Enclosure air is not local capacitor surface temperature or memory local ambient. Must measure at representative loads on the 38mm top-only six-layer core. Nominal arithmetic headroom is not thermal qualification.

remaining_gates: Confirm Micron Table 13 nominal/effective basis and relevant tolerances.
Obtain exact-part capacitance bounds or measurements at actual CReg voltage, VCCQ up to 1.95V and VCC up to 3.6V; include AC excitation/ripple, hot operation, aged life, lot/process corner.
Confirm capacitor surface temperature stays within 125C including self-heating; confirm memory local ambient stays within AAT range.
Place each pair close to the corresponding memory supply and return balls; verify impedance, transient droop, startup and sustained memory workload.
Validate assembly mask/paste/courtyard, BGA escape and physical fit independently.
future_value_option: A separately reviewed 3.3uF nominal option lies within C5 1-4.7uF and C1/C3 2.2-4.7uF, but is outside this nominal-preserving review and has not been selected or edited.
